content.user_title: Create Sales Enablement Assets That Reps Use
content.value_statement: Generic sales materials fail when they ignore the buyer, deal stage, and sales motion. This skill creates focused collateral with practical structures, proof points, and next steps.
actual_capabilities: Creates 10-to-12-slide sales deck outlines with slide goals, copy guidance, and speaker notes.
Drafts one-pagers for meeting follow-up, champion enablement, and event handouts.
Structures objection guides with buyer concerns, response approaches, proof points, and follow-up questions.
Builds timed demo scripts with discovery recaps, workflow scenes, interaction points, and closing steps.
Defines ROI calculator inputs, formulas, outputs, and sample value scenarios.
Organizes sales playbooks, buyer persona cards, case-study briefs, and proposal sections.
limitations: The skill does not verify customer claims, metrics, pricing, or product capabilities.
It provides copy and structure, not finished visual slide design or a deployed calculator.
Strong outputs require clear product positioning, buyer context, sales stage, and credible proof.
It does not automate CRM workflows, prospect research, outreach delivery, or partner platforms.

use_cases.title: Tailor a Live Deal Deck
use_cases.description: Turn discovery notes into a buyer-specific deck that connects pain, proof, ROI, implementation, and next steps.

use_cases.title: Standardize Rep Guidance
use_cases.description: Create objection responses, demo flows, persona cards, and playbook sections for consistent sales execution.

use_cases.title: Build Initial Sales Collateral
use_cases.description: Convert positioning and product evidence into practical one-pagers, proposals, and proof-focused sales materials.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic One-Pager
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a one-page sales leave-behind for [product] aimed at [persona]. Use this value proposition: [value proposition]. Include one problem, three differentiators, one proof point, and a clear next step. Ask for missing evidence before drafting.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after a meeting or when a prospect needs a concise product overview.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Objection Guide
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an objection-handling guide for [product], [persona], and [sales stage]. Cover these objections: [list]. For each objection, explain the concern, response approach, verified proof, and follow-up question. Mark any unsupported response for review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when representatives need consistent, evidence-based answers during calls.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Tailored Demo Script
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a [duration]-minute demo script for [persona] evaluating [product]. Use these discovery notes: [notes]. Map three workflows to stated pains. Add timing, talk tracks, interaction questions, proof points, and a specific close.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before a product demo that must reflect discovery findings.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Complete Sales Playbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a sales playbook for [product] entering [segment]. Include persona cards, qualification criteria, discovery questions, objection responses, a tailored demo flow, proof mapping, and proposal guidance. Separate verified facts from assumptions. Flag missing proof, pricing, security, and implementation details. Recommend quarterly review criteria.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a launch, new segment, or structured sales team onboarding.

output_examples.input: Create a post-discovery one-pager for a finance leader who wants faster monthly reporting.
output: Problem: Manual reporting delays decisions and consumes finance team capacity.
Approach: Centralize source data and automate recurring reporting workflows.
Proof: Insert a verified time-saving metric from a comparable customer.
Next step: Review the reporting workflow and confirm baseline hours this week.

output_examples.input: Prepare a response to the objection that implementation will take too long.
output_examples.output: Acknowledge the concern, show a verified phased timeline, clarify customer responsibilities, and ask which implementation constraint creates the greatest risk.

output_examples.input: Outline a 30-minute demo for a sales operations leader.
output: Three workflows tied to pipeline visibility and rep productivity: 15 minutes.
Relevant proof and implementation overview: 5 minutes.
Questions, stakeholder confirmation, and next step: 5 minutes.

best_practices: Provide verified claims, customer evidence, pricing, and implementation details before requesting final collateral.
Specify the target persona, deal stage, sales motion, intended user, and desired next action.
Test drafts with experienced representatives and review playbooks quarterly for outdated guidance.
anti_patterns: Do not invent customer quotes, performance metrics, security claims, or ROI assumptions.
Do not reuse generic collateral across buyers, industries, and sales stages without adaptation.
Do not replace a clear business story with long feature lists or dense presentation text.

faq.question: Which sales assets can this skill create?
faq.answer: It can draft decks, one-pagers, objection guides, demo scripts, ROI frameworks, playbooks, persona cards, case-study briefs, and proposals.

faq.question: Can it tailor content for different buyers?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the buyer role, priorities, objections, deal stage, and relevant proof for targeted content.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the product value proposition, differentiators, proven outcomes, sales motion, target personas, existing materials, and requested asset.

faq.question: Does it produce finished presentation files?
faq.answer: No. It provides slide-by-slide copy, speaker notes, structure, and layout guidance for a designer or presentation tool.

faq.question: Can it calculate deal-specific ROI?
faq.answer: It can define formulas and sample outputs, but you must supply validated inputs and approve every financial assumption.

faq.question: Does it handle competitor pages or cold outreach?
faq.answer: No. The skill directs competitor comparisons and cold outreach to separate specialized workflows.
